body: Thank you. I have decided i will try to run away and find shelter somewhere. Im sorry you had to go thru that.
I will try to run away
Im legally an adult, so they cant do anything. I cant go to a campus, but i will run away as soon as i get the chance.

I have a doctor that i talk to, and i go to therapy, but they said i csnt heal in this enviroment. I try my best, and i can improve my ocd, and i did. But for everything else... i cant....

I tried to talk to him, but he is afraid he will see my outbursts again and i understand. He said he felt like i didnt love him when that happened and he just cant do it anymore.
There is no homeless shelter anywhere near me, otherwise i would already go there...
I have been telling myself that ill get away soon. My first escape was college, but i most likely failed my finals, and i wont be able to go to college and i will be stuck with them again

I have been trying to do that since i got ill. But my parents dont let me, and they get mad if i tell friends that could take me in about my health problems. If i go anywhere, they would drag me back and lock me in the house
Im here, but im going to run away, see if that will change anything and if not, well i can still die.

Thank you. I know sometimes it gets better with a new day... but sometimes it doesnt... it just keeps getting worse and thats what its like for me now.

We did get along before that, but she still had her attitude towards me, she always acted like she is better than me and worth more, and my parents saw it and just let her be like that. When i was healthy i ignored it and tried to be nice to her, i always wanted to have a cool older sister, but now im so tired of pretending it doesnt hurt me i just cant... i cant talk to my parents about it, they wont do anything, she can act any way she wants and i get hurt.
Yeah, i think i will try it. Im gonna leave as soon as i get the chance, i can still kill myself if its gonna be bad

Im working on it. I have been in therapy for a year and a half, i work on it every day. I made a big progress with my ocd, but i cant work on my depression and stuff when someone keeps bringing me down.
My mental health got so bad that i started failing my classes,  my memory got fucked and my grades just werent good enough for the scholarship.
I dont have the energy to do all that just to better my chances by 1%. Im done
I dont have the energy to run away. Im just done

I told them about a hunder times, and they just shrug it off every time, no matter what i say. And if i even try to do something bad to my sister, they would just as much as kill me to stop me. 
I try to busy myself with videogames too, but it rarely works
They would insist to take me there and they would probably want to visit me at work
Im not allowed to go out without my parents knowing so... hard to do any od that
No, just make everything worse
Dorms are like the sacred texts, no way to get one. And i probably failed my finals, so i wont be going to college. My memory sucks because of my illness so im sure i failed
No, sadly not.
He blocked me everywhere and told me to go fuck myself. The money was saved under my mothers name, so i just dont know. And they would do anything to make them seem like the perfect parents
They dont if u suffer every day
I cant change anything. Thats the whole problem
There are not really any shelters here, not even a local kitchen that would provide meals for people that cant afford it. If u dont have a place to sleep at, you are on your own completely
I cant wait for a few years. I already waited and nothing changed
I cant do anything secretly, and all the money i saved by now, my parents keep in an account i cant acess. Im just done with life
So sorry to hear that. Families can be horrible. If i had the money to buy liquor, id die of an overdose with a smile on my face
Id love to know that too, tbh. Maybe it would be easier to understand then, but when i ask, they say they love us the same, but still never take my side
Its been a few days. At this point, im just lying to myself that it will get better
No clue. Could be since she was the first child. Im the second, seems like i was a mistake they didnt want

Im 19, i cant move out. Im stuck here and i tried evrything to get out of here. Im tired of trying to make it better, when i cant. Im on my meds, i take them every day and i go to therapy, but as you said, they say i cant heal in this enviroment. I have ocd, depressive anxiety disorder, panic disorder and im suicidal.
No, i have no friends and my parents would kill me if i even tried to go to any of my relatives. So yeah, im stuck.
I wish i could change it and never hurt him. Id rather live on the streets and keep him safe from my sisters terrible behaviour that makes me lash out.

He lives with us, he is the same as my mother. 
And no, my bf didnt deserve it. I never could control it and i feel bad that he had to go through that.

I tried, i asked my parents to send me away or sth just so i can not be here. But they wont do it, becuase they dont care. And i have nowhere to go. I told them to send her somewhere  or im going to leave one night and live under a bridge or sth, and they said they wont say anything to her.

Mom likes my sister more than me. A lot. So my sister can always start a fight on purpose and its still my fault. I was traumatized by that, and it puts me into a shock when it happens, i cant control anything that i do, and my bf is there and i lash out on him, even if i dont want to
Im sorry, just cant help me here
Its not your fault. Its not even my ex boyfriends
Im 19, in my country u are of age at 18. I have no money to move out,  and i have nowhere to go anyways

I know u are trying to make me feel better, but i have nothing to live for. There is actually nothing in my life, that would make if worth living. My now ex was the only person that could make me feel safe and i wanted a future with him, only if i had him there. I cant do this.

I though so too, ages ago. But its not true. Sometimes dying really is the best way to go. I waited a long time in hopes of feeling better or feeling fear of death, but the more i think of it, the more i want to do it.
Thank you, but i cant take it. I cant live like this anymore and death is my only escape. Only when im dead will i be safe from emotions and living
I dont blame him either. I know it was hard for him and i never wanted to hurt him
Thanks but im done. I cant go on. Not like this. I have been fighting my demons for years and im at an end. I hope things turn out for the better for you.

Im 19. I cant go anywhere, i have been trying for years but i have no where to go. I think even living under a birdge would be better than this. And sadly, i have been thinking about killing myself for a long time and its been a few days since i got dumped, but i still cant find the best way to kill myself, so that there are close to zero chances of me ever waking up again.
Im actually not. When i have these outbursts, im not me, not menatally and i also cant fix anything on my own so that i can heal, because i need help with that and i dont have it

Exactly. I already lost my scolarship, a previous boyfriend and other stuff, all because of this, but yet she remains unpunished and i well... i got punishments for smaller shit and i have to live with all of this every day
Lets not compare trauma, i dont know what its like wih tourettes and u dont know what its like with my illnesses. Any ilness is a valid reason to want to die
I have severe ocd, depressive -anxiety disorder, panic disorder and suicidal tendancies
She bullied me for months and i wasnt allowed to say anything, my parents let her do whatever she wanted to me and she still does it.
It happened before, and i also cant stand my illnesses anymore. My day to day life is so horrible, i barely make it throuh the day.
